register.labelZh: BUGGER 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 這些表達可能出現在英國電影、電視節目和非正式對話中。認識它們能幫助你理解說話者的態度。；bugger about 和 bugger around 可以描述某人浪費時間、胡鬧,或毫無目的地改動某物。；bugger somebody about 或 around 可以描述公司、僱主或其他人反覆改動安排,令某人白等或浪費時間。；bugger something up 是一種直接而口語化的說法,表示某人弄壞了計劃、工作、訂單或其他事情。
register.summaryEn: These expressions may appear in British films, television programmes and informal conversations. Knowing them helps you understand the speaker’s attitude. Bugger about and bugger around can describe people who are wasting time, behaving foolishly or making pointless changes to something. Bugger somebody about or around can describe a company, employer or other person who repeatedly changes arrangements and wastes someone’s time. Bugger something up is a direct informal way to say that somebody has spoiled a plan, job, order or piece of work.
